description: List bugs for the organization (flat, one row per deduplicated report). Supports filtering by status, severity, project, platform, deliveryFeed (all | urgent_critical | ui_ux), and text search. Each row includes affected_user_count, repeat_user_count, and user_spread (user_specific vs widespread). Diagnostic-class signals are excluded by default. Prefer list_bug_groups for grouped triage. A new project holds one labelled example bug (isExample: true, title starts "Example: "); it is practice data, not from the app.

deliveryFeed.description: Delivery feed: all, urgent_critical (severity Score ≥ high and confidence ≥ 0.80), or ui_ux (is_ui_ux Noul ≥ 0.70). Defaults to the PAT or project setting.

platform.description: Only bugs with an occurrence captured on this platform

search.description: Search text in title and description

name: list_bugs
title: List Bugs
